notes: Source-class attribution inventory. CIDR ranges that classify a proxy event's src_ip into a source class BEFORE pseudonymization — only the class label (application/employee/unknown) crosses the wire, never the IP. 'server' and 'ci' ranges both classify as 'application' (company-built software); 'endpoint' ranges classify as 'employee'. A src_ip in no listed range classifies as 'unknown' and keeps today's employee-tool verdict behavior (fail-safe toward flagging). PREREQUISITE: real server/DC and CI-runner ranges come from the network team; until they land here, every source is 'unknown' and verdicts are unchanged from the behavior. Overlapping ranges: most specific (longest prefix) match wins; on equal prefix length 'endpoint' beats server/ci so an employee segment mis-listed as server cannot shed the unapproved verdict.
